summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting 1Q26 results, which included the announcement that its Vale Base Metals (VBM) segment has entered into an agreement to form a consortium for Thompson operations, concluding the strategic review of the asset. No financial terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The board did not provide a recommendation or name advisors. This conclusion of a strategic review is a special situation event. The filing is a foreign private issuer report, equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K. What to watch: any future disclosures on the consortium structure, valuation, or impact on Vale's base metals portfolio.
